## Documentation

A chat.

### Parameters

- **`id`** (`int`)
  Unique identifier for this chat.

- **`type`** ([`ChatType`](../../enums/ChatType.md))
  Type of chat.

- **`is_verified`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if this chat has been verified by Telegram. Supergroups, channels and bots only.

- **`is_restricted`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if this chat has been restricted. Supergroups, channels and bots only.
  See *restriction_reason* for details.

- **`is_creator`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if this chat owner is the current user. Supergroups, channels and groups only.

- **`is_scam`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if this chat has been flagged for scam.

- **`is_fake`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if this chat has been flagged for impersonation.

- **`is_support`** (`bool`)
  True, if this chat is part of the Telegram support team. Users and bots only.

- **`is_participants_hidden`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if the chat members are hidden.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`is_join_request`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if the admin need to approve member(s) join request.

- **`is_join_to_send`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if only chat members allowed to send message in chat.

- **`is_slowmode_enabled`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if slowmode is enabled in chat.

- **`is_antispam`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if Aggressive Anti-Spam is enabled in chat.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`is_paid_reactions_available`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if paid reactions are available in chat.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`is_gifts_available`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if star gifts can be received by this chat.

- **`is_auto_translation_enabled`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if automatic translation is enabled in chat.

- **`title`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Title, for supergroups, channels and basic group chats.

- **`username`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Username, for private chats, bots, supergroups and channels if available.

- **`first_name`** (`str`, *optional*)
  First name of the other party in a private chat, for private chats and bots.

- **`last_name`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Last name of the other party in a private chat, for private chats.

- **`photo`** ([`ChatPhoto`](ChatPhoto.md), *optional*)
  Chat photo. Suitable for downloads only.

- **`stories`** (List of [`Story`](../messages_and_media/Story.md), *optional*)
  The list of chat's stories if available.

- **`wallpaper`** ([`Document`](../messages_and_media/Document.md), *optional*)
  Chat wallpaper.

- **`bio`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Bio of the other party in a private chat.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`description`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Description, for groups, supergroups and channel chats.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`dc_id`** (`int`, *optional*)
  The chat assigned DC (data center). Available only in case the chat has a photo.
  Note that this information is approximate; it is based on where Telegram stores the current chat photo.
  It is accurate only in case the owner has set the chat photo, otherwise the dc_id will be the one assigned
  to the administrator who set the current chat photo.

- **`folder_id`** (`int`, *optional*)
  The folder identifier where the chat is located.

- **`has_protected_content`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if messages from the chat can't be forwarded to other chats.

- **`invite_link`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Chat invite link, for groups, supergroups and channels.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`pinned_message`** ([`Message`](../messages_and_media/Message.md), *optional*)
  Pinned message, for groups, supergroups channels and own chat.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`sticker_set_name`** (`str`, *optional*)
  For supergroups, name of group sticker set.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`can_set_sticker_set`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if the group sticker set can be changed by you.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`members_count`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Chat members count, for groups, supergroups and channels only.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`join_requests_count`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Number of users who requested to join the chat.
  Returned only in `get slow_mode_delay (`int`, *optional*):
  For supergroups, the minimum allowed delay between consecutive messages sent by each unpriviledged user in seconds.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`restrictions`** (List of [`Restriction`](Restriction.md), *optional*)
  The list of reasons why this chat might be unavailable to some users.
  This field is available only in case *is_restricted* is True.

- **`permissions`** ([`ChatPermissions`](ChatPermissions.md) *optional*)
  Default chat member permissions, for groups and supergroups.

- **`distance`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Distance in meters of this group chat from your location.
  Returned only in `get_nearby_chats`.

- **`linked_chat`** ([`Chat`](Chat.md), *optional*)
  The linked discussion group (in case of channels) or the linked channel (in case of supergroups).
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`linked_forum`** ([`Chat`](Chat.md), *optional*)
  The linked monoforum (in case of channels) or the linked channel (in case of monoforum).
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`send_as_chat`** ([`Chat`](Chat.md), *optional*)
  The default "send_as" chat.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`available_reactions`** ([`ChatReactions`](ChatReactions.md), *optional*)
  Available reactions in the chat.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`full_name`** (`str`, *property*)
  Full name of the other party in a private chat, for private chats and bots.

- **`usernames`** (List of [`Username`](Username.md), *optional*)
  List of all chat (fragment) usernames; for private chats, supergroups and channels.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`level`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Channel boosts level.
  For channel only.

- **`reply_color`** ([`ChatColor`](ChatColor.md), *optional*)
  Chat reply color.

- **`profile_color`** ([`ChatColor`](ChatColor.md), *optional*)
  Chat profile color.

- **`business_info`** ([`BusinessInfo`](BusinessInfo.md), *optional*)
  Business information of a chat.

- **`birthday`** ([`Birthday`](Birthday.md), *optional*)
  User Date of birth.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`personal_chat`** ([`Chat`](Chat.md), *optional*)
  For private chats, the personal channel of the user.
  Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`max_reaction_count`** (`int`)
  The maximum number of reactions that can be set on a message in the chat

- **`subscription_until_date`** (`datetime`, *optional*)
  Channel members only. Date when the subscription expires.

- **`gifts_count`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Number of gifts received by the user.

- **`bot_verification`** ([`BotVerification`](BotVerification.md), *optional*)
  Information about bot verification.

- **`community_id`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Identifier of the community the chat belongs to.
  For supergroups, channels and bots.

- **`is_collapsed`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if the community is collapsed in the chat list.
  For communities only.

- **`community_chats`** (List of [`CommunityChat`](CommunityChat.md), *optional*)
  Chats belonging to the community.
  For communities only. Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`administrators_count`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Number of administrators of the chat.
  For supergroups, channels and communities. Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`banned_members_count`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Number of users banned from the chat.
  For supergroups, channels and communities. Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`chat_requests_count`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Number of pending requests to add chats to the community.
  For community administrators only. Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`has_welcome_messages`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if the chat has welcome messages (see [`get_chat_welcome_messages`](../../methods/chats/get_chat_welcome_messages.md)).
  For groups, supergroups and channels. Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`guard_bot`** ([`User`](User.md), *optional*)
  The guard bot of the chat, which approves the join requests of new members.
  For supergroups. Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`uses_unofficial_app`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  True, if the user uses an unofficial application that poses a security risk.
  For private chats. Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).

- **`manager_bot`** ([`User`](User.md), *optional*)
  The bot that manages the bot.
  For bots. Returned only in [`get_chat`](../../methods/chats/get_chat.md).
